A '''medical facility''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]]. Prior to [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[11-4D/Legends|11-4D]] worked at the facility, researching and performing various [[Doctor/Legends|surgeries]] on a wide range of [[Species/Legends|species]]. The facility later gave 11-4D to the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Ellin Lah]] temporarily in place of payments for services Lah had provided the facility. However, Lah kept the droid instead of returning it.
